sub_answers.text: Reviewers generally praised Hanamori's artwork as delicate and curvy [d1516470s8p0]. Publishers Weekly described the first volume as an "industrial-strength shōjo" with "cardboard villains" and a "recycled love story" [d1516470s8p0]. Anime News Network stated that, for older readers, the story was childish and "barely coherent" with confusing narrative gaps [d1516470s8p0]. Mania.com scored volumes Cs and below and gave the final volume an F−, calling the characters and storytelling "offensively stupid" [d1516470s8p0].

sub_answers.text: In 1980 Grosset & Dunlap sued the Syndicate and Simon & Schuster over breach of contract, copyright infringement, and unfair competition related to the Nancy Drew/Hardy Boys publishing changes, and Harriet Adams countersued claiming authorship rights, with court testimony revealing Mildred Benson's role in early manuscript authorship [d54832s9p0]. Naik accused Darling Krishna of plagiarizing their narrated script in the film Love Mocktail 3, and Krishna denied the allegations and announced plans to file a defamation suit [d82736999s5p0]. Copyright has been used by organizations to pursue claims that restrict distribution of historical and religious texts, exemplified by disputes over Aleister Crowley's works involving the Ordo Templi Orientis (OTO) [d76512238s3p0].

sub_answers.text: One Piece reached over 300 million copies in circulation by November 2013 and over 600 million copies in circulation worldwide by March 2026 [d360759s18p0]. One Piece was the best-selling manga series for eleven consecutive years from 2008 until 2018 [d360759s18p0]. The series had specific annual rankings and sales figures: it ranked second in 2019 with over 10.1 million copies sold, third in 2020 with over 7.7 million copies sold, sixth in 2021 with over 7 million copies sold, fourth in 2022 with over 10.3 million copies sold, and was the fifth best-selling manga in the first half of 2023 with over 3.5 million copies sold in that period [d360759s18p0]. By 2004, One Piece brand merchandise had made more than $1 billion in retail sales in Japan [d360759s18p0].

sub_answers.text: Kodansha USA licensed The Witch and the Beast for English publication [d68485537s3p0]. Seven Seas Entertainment announced English licenses for Ghost & Witch and for The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System's manga (announcement dates in 2025 for both) [d80813185s2p0][d77568450s3p0]. Kodansha Ranobe Books acquired and published the light novel The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System in print under Kodansha's imprint, and Kodansha serialized and transferred its manga between web and weekly magazine platforms [d77568450s0p0][d77568450s3p0]. Other international publication deals include Ki-oon publishing Tsugumi Project in France, ADV Manga publishing More Starlight to Your Heart in English, Comikey publishing Star: Strike It Rich in English, and Pinsin Studio and Sichuan Literature and Art Publishing House publishing Grandmaster of Demonic Cultivation editions in Traditional and Simplified Chinese respectively [d71631623s1p0][d6347435s2p0][d78073446s2p0][d70752333s4p0].
